51: // UnboundedLog::Instance and the sharded log entry projection.
52: tokenized_state_machine! {
53: UnboundedLog<DT: Dispatch> {
54:     fields {
55:         #[sharding(map)]
56:         pub log: Map<LogIdx, LogEntry<DT>>,

67: ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
68: //
69: // Cyclic Buffer
70: // =============
71: //
72: // The cyclic buffer is a bounded log with multiple readers and writers. A writer will check whether
73: // there's enough space in the log and the reserve space to place its update operations into the log.
74: // Log space can be reclaimed once all readers have advanced their read pointers accordingly.
75: //
76: ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
77: 
78: verus! {
79: 
80: /// Logical Log Index
81: ///
82: /// In contrast to the unbounded log, the log entries can be "negative". This is used for the
83: /// initialization where all entries are initialized with the range [-LOG_SIZE, 0)
84: pub type LogicalLogIdx = int;
85: 
86: /// The size of the log. XXX: can we get rid of this?
87: 
88: /// An entry in the log
89: ///
90: ///
91: pub tracked struct StoredType<DT: Dispatch> {
92:     pub cell_perms: PointsTo<Option<ConcreteLogEntry<DT>>>,
93:     pub log_entry: Option<UnboundedLog::log<DT>>,
94: }
95: 
96: pub open spec fn stored_type_inv<DT: Dispatch>(
97:     st: StoredType<DT>,
98:     idx: int,
99:     cell_id: CellId,
100:     unbounded_log_instance: UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>,
101: ) -> bool {
102:     // also match the cell id
103:     &&& st.cell_perms.mem_contents().is_init()
104:     &&& st.cell_perms@.pcell == cell_id
105:     &&& idx >= 0 ==> {
106:         &&& st.log_entry matches Some(log_entry)
107:         &&& log_entry.key() == idx
108:         &&& log_entry.instance_id() == unbounded_log_instance.id()
109:         &&& st.cell_perms.mem_contents().value() matches Some(cell_perms_value)
110:         &&& cell_perms_value.node_id as NodeId
111:             == log_entry.value().node_id
112:         &&& cell_perms_value.op == log_entry.value().op
113:     }
114:     &&& idx < 0 ==> {
115:         &&& true
116:     }
117: }
118: 
119: ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
120: // Read Only Operations
121: ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
122: ///
123: #[is_variant]
124: pub tracked enum ReaderState<DT: Dispatch> {
125:     ///
126:     Starting {
127:         ///
128:         start: LogIdx,
129:     },
130:     /// reader in the range
131:     Range { start: LogIdx, end: LogIdx, cur: LogIdx },
132:     /// Guard
133:     Guard { start: LogIdx, end: LogIdx, cur: LogIdx, val: StoredType<DT> },
134: }
135: 
136: ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
137: // Combiner
138: ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
139: /// represents the combiner
140: #[is_variant]
141: pub tracked enum CombinerState<DT: Dispatch> {
142:     Idle,
143:     Reading(ReaderState<DT>),
144:     AdvancingHead { idx: LogIdx, min_local_version: LogIdx },
145:     AdvancingTail { observed_head: LogIdx },
146:     Appending { cur_idx: LogIdx, tail: LogIdx },
147: }
148: 
149: impl<DT: Dispatch> CombinerState<DT> {
150:     pub open spec fn no_overlap_with(self, other: Self) -> bool {
151:         match self {
152:             CombinerState::Appending { cur_idx, tail } => {
153:                 match other {
154:                     CombinerState::Reading(ReaderState::Guard { start, end, cur, val }) => {
155:                         (cur_idx > cur)  // self is after the other
156:                          || (tail <= cur)  // self is before the other
157: 
158:                     },
159:                     CombinerState::Appending { cur_idx: cur_idx2, tail: tail2 } => {
160:                         (cur_idx >= tail2)  // self is after the other
161:                          || (tail <= cur_idx2)  // self is before the other
162: 
163:                     },
164:                     _ => { true },
165:                 }
166:             },
167:             _ => { true },
168:         }
169:     }
170: }

172: tokenized_state_machine! { CyclicBuffer<DT: Dispatch> {
173:     fields {
174:         #[sharding(constant)]
175:         pub unbounded_log_instance: UnboundedLog::Instance::<DT>,
176: 
177:         #[sharding(constant)]
178:         pub cell_ids: Seq<CellId>,
179: 
180:         /// the size of the buffer
181:         #[sharding(constant)]
182:         pub buffer_size: LogIdx,
183: 
184:         /// the number of replicas
185:         #[sharding(constant)]
186:         pub num_replicas: nat,
187: 
188:         // Logical index into the above slice at which the log starts.
189:         // Note: the head does _not_ necessarily advance monotonically.
190:         // (It could go backwards in the event of two threads overlapping
191:         // in their AdvancingHead cycles.)
192:         // It's only guaranteed to be <= all the local heads.
193: 
194:         #[sharding(variable)]
195:         pub head: LogIdx,
196: 
197:         // Logical index into the above slice at which the log ends.
198:         // New appends go here.
199: 
200:         #[sharding(variable)]
201:         pub tail: LogIdx,
202: 
203:         // Array consisting of the local head of each replica registered with the log.
204:         // Required for garbage collection; since replicas make progress over the log
205:         // independently, we want to make sure that we don't garbage collect operations
206:         // that haven't been executed by all replicas.
207: 
208:         #[sharding(map)]
209:         pub local_versions: Map<NodeId, LogIdx>,    // previously called local_tails
210: 
211:         /// the contents of the buffer/log.
212:         #[sharding(storage_map)]
213:         pub contents: Map<LogicalLogIdx, StoredType<DT>>,
214: 
215:         // The 'alive' bit flips back and forth. So sometimes 'true' means 'alive',
216:         // and sometimes 'false' means 'alive'.
217:         // entry is an index into the buffer (0 <= entry < LOG_SIZE)
218: 
219:         #[sharding(map)]
220:         pub alive_bits: Map</* entry: */ LogIdx, /* bit: */ bool>,
221: 
222:         #[sharding(map)]
223:         pub combiner: Map<NodeId, CombinerState<DT>>
224:     }
225: 
226: 
227:     ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
228:     // Invariant
229:     ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
230: 
231: 
232:     #[invariant]
233:     pub spec fn log_size(&self) -> bool {
234:         self.buffer_size == LOG_SIZE
235:     }
236: 
237:     #[invariant]
238:     pub spec fn cell_ids(&self) -> bool {
239:         self.cell_ids.len() == self.buffer_size
240:     }
241: 
242:     #[invariant]
243:     pub spec fn complete(&self) -> bool {
244:         &&& (forall |i| 0 <= i < self.num_replicas <==> self.local_versions.contains_key(i))
245:         &&& (forall |i| 0 <= i < self.buffer_size  <==> self.alive_bits.contains_key(i))
246:         &&& (forall |i| 0 <= i < self.num_replicas <==> self.combiner.contains_key(i))
247:         &&& (forall |i| self.contents.contains_key(i) ==> -self.buffer_size <= i < self.tail)
248:     }
249: 
250:     #[invariant]
251:     pub spec fn pointer_ordering(&self) -> bool {
252:         &&& self.head <= self.tail
253:         &&& (forall |i| #[trigger] self.local_versions.contains_key(i) ==>
254:             self.head <= self.local_versions[i] <= self.tail)
255:         &&& (forall |i| #[trigger] self.local_versions.contains_key(i) ==>
256:             self.tail <= self.local_versions[i] +  self.buffer_size)
257:     }
258: 
259:     #[invariant]
260:     pub spec fn pointer_differences(&self) -> bool {
261:         forall |i| self.local_versions.contains_key(i) ==>
262:             self.local_versions[i] <= self.tail <= self.local_versions[i] + self.buffer_size
263:     }
264: 
265:     #[invariant]
266:     pub spec fn ranges_no_overlap(&self) -> bool {
267:         (forall |i, j| self.combiner.contains_key(i) && self.combiner.contains_key(j) && i != j ==>
268:             self.combiner[i].no_overlap_with(self.combiner[j])
269:         )
270:     }
271: 
272:     #[invariant]
273:     pub spec fn upcoming_bits_are_not_alive(&self) -> bool {
274:         let min_local_head = map_min_value(self.local_versions, (self.num_replicas - 1) as nat);
275:         forall |i|
276:             self.tail <= i < min_local_head + self.buffer_size
277:             ==> !log_entry_is_alive(self.alive_bits, i, self.buffer_size)
278:     }
279: 
280:     #[invariant]
281:     pub spec fn inv_buffer_contents(&self) -> bool {
282:         &&& (forall |i: int| self.tail - self.buffer_size <= i < self.tail ==> (
283:             (log_entry_is_alive(self.alive_bits, i, self.buffer_size) ||
284:                 i < map_min_value(self.local_versions, (self.num_replicas - 1) as nat))
285:             <==>
286:             #[trigger] self.contents.contains_key(i)
287:         ))
288:         &&& (forall |i: int| self.tail <= i ==> ! #[trigger] self.contents.contains_key(i))
289:     }
290: 
291:     #[invariant]
292:     pub spec fn contents_meet_inv(&self) -> bool {
293:         forall |i: int| #[trigger] self.contents.contains_key(i) ==>
294:             stored_type_inv(self.contents[i], i, self.cell_ids[log_entry_idx(i, self.buffer_size) as int], self.unbounded_log_instance)
295:     }
296: 
297:     #[invariant]
298:     pub spec fn all_reader_state_valid(&self) -> bool {
299:         forall |node_id| #![trigger self.combiner[node_id]] #[trigger] self.combiner.contains_key(node_id) && self.combiner[node_id].is_Reading() ==>
300:           self.reader_state_valid(node_id, self.combiner[node_id].get_Reading_0())
301:     }
302: 
303:     pub closed spec fn reader_state_valid(&self, node_id: NodeId, rs: ReaderState<DT>) -> bool {
304:         match rs {
305:             ReaderState::Starting{start} => {
306:                 // the starting value should match the local tail
307:                 &&& start == self.local_versions[node_id]
308:                 &&& start <= self.tail
309:             }
310:             ReaderState::Range{start, end, cur} => {
311:                 // the start must be our local tail
312:                 &&& self.local_versions[node_id] == start
313:                 // the start must be before the end, can be equial if ltail == tail
314:                 &&& start <= end
315:                 // we've read the tail, but the tail may have moved
316:                 &&& (self.tail as int) - (self.buffer_size as int) <= end <= (self.tail as int)
317:                 // current is between start and end
318:                 &&& start <= cur <= end
319:                 // the entries up to, and including  current must be alive
320:                 &&& (forall |i| start <= i < cur ==> log_entry_is_alive(self.alive_bits, i, self.buffer_size))
321:                 // the entries up to, and including current must have something in the log
322:                 &&& (forall |i| start <= i < cur ==> self.contents.contains_key(i))
323:             }
324:             ReaderState::Guard{start, end, cur, val} => {
325:                 // the start must be our local tail
326:                 &&& self.local_versions[node_id] == start
327:                 // the start must be before the end, can be equial if ltail == tail
328:                 &&& start <= end
329:                 // we've read the tail, but the tail may have moved
330:                 &&& (self.tail as int) - (self.buffer_size as int) <= end <= (self.tail as int)
331:                 // current is between start and end
332:                 &&& start <= cur < end
333:                 // the entries up to, and including  current must be alive
334:                 &&& (forall |i| start <= i <= cur ==> log_entry_is_alive(self.alive_bits, i, self.buffer_size))
335:                 // the entries up to, and including current must have something in the log
336:                 &&& (forall |i| start <= i <= cur ==> self.contents.contains_key(i))
337:                 // the thing we are ready should match the log content
338:                 &&& self.contents.contains_key(cur as int)
339:                 &&& self.contents[cur as int] === val
340:             }
341:         }
342:     }
343: 
344:     #[invariant]
345:     pub spec fn all_combiner_valid(&self) -> bool {
346:         forall |node_id| #[trigger] self.combiner.contains_key(node_id) ==>
347:           self.combiner_valid(node_id, self.combiner[node_id])
348:     }
349: 
350:     pub closed spec fn combiner_valid(&self, node_id: NodeId, cs: CombinerState<DT>) -> bool {
351:         match cs {
352:             CombinerState::Idle => true,
353:             CombinerState::Reading(_) => true, // see reader_state_valid instead
354:             CombinerState::AdvancingHead{idx, min_local_version} => {
355:                 // the index is always within the defined replicas
356:                 &&& idx <= self.num_replicas as nat
357:                 // forall replicas we'e seen, min_local_version is smaller than all localTails
358:                 &&& (forall |n| 0 <= n < idx ==> min_local_version <= self.local_versions[n])
359:             }
360:             CombinerState::AdvancingTail{observed_head} => {
361:                 // the observed head is smaller than all local tails
362:                 &&& (forall |n| 0 <= n < self.num_replicas as nat ==> observed_head <= self.local_versions[n])
363:             }
364:             CombinerState::Appending{cur_idx, tail} => {
365:                 // the current index is between local tails and tail.
366:                 &&& self.local_versions[node_id] <= cur_idx <= tail
367:                 // the read tail is smaller or equal to the current tail.
368:                 &&& tail <= self.tail
369:                 //
370:                 &&& (self.tail as int) - (self.buffer_size as int) <= cur_idx <= (self.tail as int)
371:                 // all the entries we're writing must not be alive.
372:                 &&& (forall |i : nat| cur_idx <= i < tail ==> (
373:                   !(log_entry_is_alive(self.alive_bits, i as int, self.buffer_size))))
374:             }
375:         }
376:     }
377: 
378: 
379:     ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
380:     // Initialization
381:     ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
382: 
383:     init!{
384:         initialize(buffer_size: nat, num_replicas: nat, contents: Map<int, StoredType<DT>>, cell_ids: Seq<CellId>, unbounded_log_instance: UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>, ) {
385:             require(num_replicas > 0);
386:             require(buffer_size == LOG_SIZE);
387:             require(cell_ids.len() == buffer_size);
388: 
389:             init unbounded_log_instance = unbounded_log_instance;
390:             init cell_ids = cell_ids;
391:             init buffer_size = buffer_size;
392:             init num_replicas = num_replicas;
393:             init head = 0;
394:             init tail = 0;
395:             init local_versions = Map::new(Set::range(0, num_replicas), |i: NodeId| 0);
396: 
397:             require(forall |i: int| (-buffer_size <= i < 0 <==> contents.contains_key(i)));
398:             require(forall |i: int| #[trigger] contents.contains_key(i) ==> stored_type_inv(contents[i], i, cell_ids[log_entry_idx(i, buffer_size) as int], unbounded_log_instance));
399:             init contents = contents;
400: 
401:             init alive_bits = Map::new(Set::range(0, buffer_size), |i: nat| !log_entry_alive_value(i as int, buffer_size));
402:             init combiner = Map::new(Set::range(0, num_replicas), |i: NodeId| CombinerState::Idle);
403:         }
404:     }
405: 
406: 
407:     ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
408:     // Reader Transitions
409:     ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
410:     //
411:     // The reader transitions traverse the log and read the entries in it.
412:     //
413: 
414:     /// start the reader on the provided node, the combiner must be in idle state.
415:     transition!{
416:         reader_start(node_id: NodeId) {
417:             have   local_versions    >= [ node_id => let local_head ];
418: 
419:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => CombinerState::Idle ];
420:             add    combiner += [
421:                 node_id => CombinerState::Reading(ReaderState::Starting { start: local_head })
422:             ];
423:         }
424:     }
425: 
426:     /// enter the reading phase
427:     transition!{
428:         reader_enter(node_id: NodeId) {
429:             remove combiner -= [
430:                 node_id => let CombinerState::Reading(ReaderState::Starting { start })
431:             ];
432:             add combiner += [
433:                 node_id => CombinerState::Reading(ReaderState::Range { start, end: pre.tail, cur: start })
434:             ];
435:             assert start <= pre.tail;
436:         }
437:     }
438: 
439:     /// read the value of the current entry to process it
440:     transition!{
441:         reader_guard(node_id: NodeId) {
442:             remove combiner -= [
443:                 node_id => let CombinerState::Reading( ReaderState::Range{ start, end, cur })
444:             ];
445: 
446:             require(cur < end);
447: 
448:             have alive_bits >= [ log_entry_idx(cur as int, pre.buffer_size) => log_entry_alive_value(cur as int, pre.buffer_size) ];
449: 
450:             birds_eye let val = pre.contents.index(cur as int);
451: 
452:             add combiner += [
453:                 node_id => CombinerState::Reading( ReaderState::Guard{ start, end, cur, val })
454:             ];
455: 
456:             // assert(stored_type_inv(val, cur as int));
457:         }
458:     }
459: 
460:     /// the value of the log must not change while we're processing it
461:     property!{
462:         guard_guards(node_id: NodeId) {
463:             have combiner >= [
464:                 node_id => let CombinerState::Reading( ReaderState::Guard{ start, end, cur, val })
465:             ];
466:             guard contents >= [ cur as int => val ];
467: 
468:             assert(stored_type_inv(val, cur as int, pre.cell_ids[log_entry_idx(cur as int, pre.buffer_size) as int],  pre.unbounded_log_instance));
469:         }
470:     }
471: 
472:     /// finish processing the entry, increase current pointer
473:     transition!{
474:         reader_unguard(node_id: NodeId) {
475:             remove combiner -= [
476:                 node_id => let CombinerState::Reading(ReaderState::Guard{ start, end, cur, val })
477:             ];
478:             add combiner += [
479:                 node_id => CombinerState::Reading(ReaderState::Range{ start, end, cur: cur + 1 })
480:             ];
481:         }
482:     }
483: 
484:     /// finish the reading whith, place the combiner into the idle state
485:     transition!{
486:         reader_finish(node_id: NodeId) {
487:             remove combiner -= [
488:                 node_id => let CombinerState::Reading(ReaderState::Range{ start, end, cur })
489:             ];
490:             add    combiner += [ node_id => CombinerState::Idle ];
491: 
492:             remove local_versions -= [ node_id => let _ ];
493:             add    local_versions += [ node_id => end ];
494: 
495:             require(cur == end);
496:         }
497:     }
498: 
499:     /// abort reading, place the combiner back into the idle state
500:     transition!{
501:         reader_abort(node_id: NodeId) {
502:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => let CombinerState::Reading(r) ];
503:             add    combiner += [ node_id => CombinerState::Idle ];
504: 
505:             require(r.is_Starting() || r.is_Range());
506:         }
507:     }
508: 
509: 
510:     ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
511:     // Advance Head Transitions
512:     ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
513:     //
514:     // The advance head transitions update the global head of the log with the minimum value
515:     // of all local heads.
516: 
517:     /// start the advancing of the head by reading the local head of node 0
518:     transition!{
519:         advance_head_start(node_id: NodeId) {
520:             have   local_versions >= [ 0 => let local_head_0 ];
521:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => CombinerState::Idle ];
522:             add    combiner += [ node_id => CombinerState::AdvancingHead { idx: 1, min_local_version: local_head_0,} ];
523:         }
524:     }
525: 
526:     /// read the next local head
527:     transition!{
528:         advance_head_next(node_id: NodeId) {
529:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => let CombinerState::AdvancingHead { idx, min_local_version } ];
530: 
531:             have   local_versions    >= [ idx => let local_head_at_idx ];
532:             require(idx < pre.num_replicas);
533: 
534:             let new_min = min(min_local_version, local_head_at_idx);
535:             add combiner += [ node_id => CombinerState::AdvancingHead { idx: idx + 1, min_local_version: new_min } ];
536:         }
537:     }
538: 
539:     /// update the head value with the current collected miniumu
540:     transition!{
541:         advance_head_finish(node_id: NodeId) {
542:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => let CombinerState::AdvancingHead { idx, min_local_version } ];
543:             add    combiner += [ node_id => CombinerState::Idle ];
544:             update head      = min_local_version;
545: 
546:             require(idx == pre.num_replicas);
547:         }
548:     }
549: 
550:     /// stop the advancing head transition without uppdating the head
551:     transition!{
552:         advance_head_abort(node_id: NodeId) {
553:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => let CombinerState::AdvancingHead { .. } ];
554:             add    combiner += [ node_id => CombinerState::Idle ];
555:         }
556:     }
557: 
558: 
559:     ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
560:     // Advance Tail Transitions
561:     ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
562:     //
563:     // The advance tail transition bump the tail of the log to make space for new entries.
564:     // We first read the current head as this defines the maximum value the tail can be advanced to
565:     // as we need to ensure that we do not overrun existing entries.
566: 
567:     /// start the advancing of the head tail by reading the head value
568:     transition!{
569:         advance_tail_start(node_id: NodeId) {
570:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => CombinerState::Idle ];
571:             add    combiner += [ node_id => CombinerState::AdvancingTail { observed_head: pre.head } ];
572:         }
